title: Norman Reedus Bids Farewell To 'The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon' After Wrapping Final Season: "Hits Way Different This Time" - NewsBreak
text:
By Glenn Garner ,
42 minutes ago After 16 years of surviving The Walking Dead franchise, Norman Reedus is joining the land of the living.
‘The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon’ Renewed For Fourth & Final Season
On Tuesday, the Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon star bid farewell to his eponymous zombie hunter after putting “so much heart” into the fourth and final season of the AMC spin-off, which recently wrapped.
“Finally going through these photos to check off from the last episode now that I’m back from Mongolia it was really hard to kill any of them,” he captioned behind-the-scenes photos of Season 4. “I didn’t post any of those here, but I can’t wait for people to see this show the crew best I’ve ever worked with the feeling of accomplishment when it was over was just amazing.”
Reedus continued, “Such hard work and so much [heart] put into this I think you’re gonna feel it. It was a special season. I can’t wait for you to see it. It hits just way different this time.”
‘The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon’ Teases Season 3 Finale Clip & Season 4 BTS Footage — NYCC
While teasing Season 4 at New York Comic Con in October, Carol actress Melissa McBride said it’s “going to be even better” than Season 3, as Reedus raved they’re “killing it” on the final season.
Norman Reedus as Daryl Dixon and Melissa McBride as Carol Peletier in ‘The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon’ (Carla Oset/AMC) Carla Oset/AMC The fifth spin-off of The Walking Dead (2010-’22), TWD: Daryl Dixon follows Daryl and Carol on their journey home to their loved ones after washing up in France, where the zombie virus originated.
Last July, the show was renewed for its fourth and final season , which filmed on-location in Spain.
